review_type: Explicit AI metadata-only judgments; no audio assessment or new human grades

rubric.0: Unsupported/unrelated, dominant conflict with the request, or hard-constraint violation. Missing tags are not proof of audible irrelevance.
rubric.1: Partial genre/mood/context support, adjacent style, or insufficient evidence for the complete request.
rubric.2: Strong verified metadata support for the complete literal request and context.

policy: Literal query and supplied context take priority over helper arrays.
Titles and artist names do not establish genre, mood, instrumentation or musical similarity.
No retrieval method, rank, retrieval score, embedding or AI/human label was supplied in the new-pair review input.
The reviewer has prior project context and historical aggregate results; this is not an independent human or fully blind assessment.
Seed metadata was inspected in the local catalog. Numb by 21 Savage has only artist and Hip-Hop/Rap tags; no trap style is inferred.
Genre exclusions and known-track identity remain hard constraints. Seed-based requests require more than a generic genre match for strong credit.
No ranking parameters were changed and no grades were selected or revised to improve a system score.
No audio was played; sparse/noisy/conflicting folksonomic tags limit validity.
